title: Engineering Event
description: A normalized engineering event captured by Streeling for the Supervisor event feed.

observed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was observed.

repo.description: The repository where the event occurred.

issue_or_pr.description: Reference to the issue or PR number.

actor.description: The identity of the entity that triggered the event.

worker.description: The specific worker type if applicable.

capability.description: The capability associated with the event.

severity.description: The severity level of the event.

durable_url.description: A durable link to the original event source.

summary.description: A human-readable summary of the event.

raw_ref.description: A reference to the raw event data.

metadata.description: Additional event-specific metadata (e.g., cost details, workflow IDs).
